summary: GROUP_CONCAT combines the values in each group into one piece of text.
points: GROUP_CONCAT(name) joins values with commas by default.
A second value sets the separator: GROUP_CONCAT(name, '; ').
Add ORDER BY inside it to control the order: GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY name).
DISTINCT removes repeats, but it works only with the default comma separator.

example.explanation: Each category becomes one row, with its product names listed alphabetically.
